svg.title: What I do and what I enjoy
svg.desc: Capabilities: Offensive security: VAPT / WAPT, reverse engineering and fuzzing; AI security operations: SIEM, UEBA, alert triage and response; Autonomous agents: Multi-agent harnesses with long-term memory; Local AI: Fine-tuned, offline models on my own GPU; Full-stack products: Web, mobile and SaaS for NextaSol clients. Interests: Agentic AI, CTF and reverse engineering, Reading the market, Hardware tinkering.
